name: wtf
description: Select text, run /wtf, and a side pane explains what it means in the context of this conversation, without adding anything to the conversation.

hotkey.title: Hotkey button
hotkey.description: Keep an invisible button at the end of the hint line under the prompt, so a key you bind to app:cycleDiffBase asks about the selection even while the pane is closed. See the README before turning it on.
